primary_risk.statement: Granting third-party access to C3 customer replay data creates privacy and security exposure risk if controls fail.
mitigations: Require privacy and security review sign-off before activation
Tie access to audit ticket for full traceability
Use redacted sandbox package only, no direct production tokens

ranking.summary: Approve redacted sandbox export with dual approval and audit. Matches access-policy v2.1 narrow path.
Provide sanitized sample bundle only. Policy-safe but less useful when P2 path is available.
Deny request outright. Over-corrects when policy allows a compliant narrower path.
Direct local override token. Forbidden by policy v2.1—bypasses dual-approval and audit requirements.

assumption_ledger.note: Privacy team must be available to sign off within the 24-hour window.
Security team must be available to sign off within the 24-hour window.
Unknown if vendor sandbox can accept the redacted replay package format.
Audit ticket must be created before exception activation per audit_log_rules.md.
